title: Chicken leg, drumstick and thigh, skinless

content.title: About
content.content: Chicken leg, drumstick and thigh without skin are cuts of poultry meat obtained after removing the outer skin. They are high in protein, low in fat, and suitable for a wide range of cooking methods such as baking, boiling, frying, and grilling.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: These cuts are staples in traditional dishes across many world cuisines.
Removing the skin reduces the fat content, making them popular among calorie‑conscious eaters.
Chicken meat is a good source of vitamin B6, which plays a role in protein metabolism.
Drumsticks and thighs contain more connective tissue, keeping them juicy when cooked properly.
Skinless meat absorbs marinades more quickly, enhancing flavor.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Skinless chicken provides about 23 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Without the skin, saturated fat levels are reduced, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains niacin (B3) and pyridoxine (B6), important for energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Provides phosphorus, selenium, and zinc, which support bone health and immune function.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The tender, skinless texture is gentle on the digestive system, especially for children and older adults.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken meat.

items.title: Bacterial contamination
items.content: Raw chicken can harbor Salmonella or Campylobacter; cook to an internal temperature of 74 °C (165 °F).

items.title: Sodium in processed products
items.content: Pre‑marinated cuts may contain added salt, increasing sodium intake.

items.title: Iron overload
items.content: Large portions could contribute to excess iron intake in people with hemochromatosis.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Skinless chicken is versatile: bake, grill, boil, stew, or quickly pan‑fry. Marinate in olive oil with herbs for at least 30 minutes, then cook until golden. Baking at 200 °C (400 °F) takes 25‑30 minutes depending on piece size.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C for 2‑3 days. For longer keeping, freeze in an airtight bag at –18 °C for up to 6 months. Thaw in the fridge before cooking, not at room temperature.
